description: Public-safe schema for routing discovery artifacts to required external capabilities without naming private people, locations, or personal contexts.
acceptance_criteria: Every router record must name at least one required capability.
Every capability must include a unique capability_id, category, priority, and reason.
Every success criterion must be public-safe and independently checkable.
The router must reject non-public metadata.
Routing output must be deterministic for identical inputs.
falsification_route: The schema or router is invalid if records with missing capabilities, duplicate capability identifiers, undefined categories, absent success criteria, or private metadata pass validation.
